title: Sable and the Will
author: Kestrel Coldharbour
blurb: August Sterling, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
